protocol.scope: Two product-only single-step validation cases; identical root inference to previous three cases; exploratory, not official evaluation
protocol.embedding: ETKDGv3 of current product; MMFF94 or UFF; fragment coordinates sliced only from this product
protocol.unsupported: atom centers, ring bonds, non-single bonds, fragments smaller than two heavy atoms; no backfill beyond original top ten
protocol.ranking: sum across centers of center_softmax_probability * exact hydrogen-restored precursor-set frequency / 30; ties lexical
protocol.leaves: depth/node-size stop only, not a claim of commercial availability
protocol.decoder: Windows Open Babel 3.1.0 XYZ, fixed generic hydrogen restoration, RDKit sanitization; reject radicals, charges and disconnected per-fragment outputs
protocol.validation: structural checks only; not a feasibility predictor or wet-lab validation
protocol.failures: retain failed slots; no target-guided retries or reseeding; diagnostic runtime failures abort
protocol.size_batching: each fragment independently to avoid padding-dependent size probabilities
